assert(lo['index'],lo['name'],lo['op'],lo['a'],lo['b'])==(1,'delta','div',z['residual']['component_words'][-1],den['y'])
v=t['nearest'](lo['y'],t['pf'](lo['a'])/D);assert v==t['F'](1,2**1055)and 0<v<t['F'](1,2**1022)
print(json.dumps(dict(status='PASS',public_API_valid=1,closed_selector_STOP=1,missing_parent_SIMULATED_STOP=1,
 synthetic_scalar_underflow_STOP=z,additional_RN_nodes=177,additional_products=3,additional_sums=3,new_sqrt_calls=0),sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))
